Question 10 Marks for correct response: 1.00 Negative marking: 0.00 A man invested x rupees for 5 years at a rate of 2.5% simple interest. If he received an interest of 125000 after 5 years, find the amount he invested. Marks awarded 0 Difficulty - Attempt% 62 Correct% 45 Your time 6 Avg time 104 The amount he received after 5 years as interest = 125000 rupees, which implies he received 125000 / 5 = 25000 rupees interest each year. The interest percentage = 2.5% of the amount he invested. 2.5% = 25000, 100% = 25000 / 2.5 * 100 = 10,00,000 The amount he invested = 10,00,000 rupees.
